reviews.x: I was thrilled when I saw this product. My mother used to wear this throughout my childhood. Then the formula changed and she stopped wearing it. I got my order today. It's very close but not exactly. I purchased it solely as just a memory from my childhood and not to wear. So, for that purpose, it's close enough. Really wish I could find the REAL original Wild Cody Musk before they changed the formula which I think lead to its demise. Pitty really.

Well I was excited and ordered the musk oil took 4 weeks to get here. Could not wait to open but guess what? Did not even smell. I was soo disappointed. Well I might try the cologne spray. Can anyone tell me which to buy that smells like it suppose to?

This is not the same product that you bought in the 70’s!  This basically smells like nothing!  The Coty Musk oil from back in the day.....you could put 1 drop on and you could smell it all day!  This shouldn’t get even one star but it wouldn’t let me leave a comment without at least one!

reviews.t: Not like the same product at all. This is definitly
reviews.x: I grew up with this fragrance in a larger jar, I loved the fragrance. My daughter also wore it. This a weak smell, as if there were a couple of drops with neutral oil in an extremely small bottle.
This smells nothing like the Original Coty Oil I remember. The bottle it came in is so small I just had to laugh. Complete waste of money cause it's not returnable.

reviews.t: this is definitely not the Musk oil of my Dreams.
reviews.x: this smelled like the concoction that they attempt to sell as Musk Oil in Spray Form.  It smells horrible! I was very disappointed after paying this much for a Stink Bottle of Oil.

reviews.t: Waste of time and money! Fraud not the same oil from Coty
reviews.x: Doesn’t smell like the original oil I use to buy and the bottle is super tiny! Don’t bother buying this from this seller!
I love the scent but it took a long time to arrive in the mail.

reviews.t: THIS MOST DEFINITELY ISN'T MADE BY COTY OR ORIGINAL
reviews.x: I read the reviews but figured I'd try it for myself.  Even if it was close, I might be happy.  I sincerely doubt that Coty would put out a product like this, and I wonder if they're aware that someone is cashing in on their name,  This smells more like a man's musk aftershave or something. It's missing whatever gave the oil it's warm smell.  It's definitely smaller than it's supposed to be.  I can't blame whoever is manufacturing this for doing it.  I mean the braindeads at Coty aren't smart en

I used to love the original Coty musk, so when I saw this product I was super excited! It came in today and the scent does not at all smell like the original Coty and the bottle is so small. I will not use this and definitely will not reorder. Very disappointed.

reviews.t: Wish I read the reviews before purchasing
reviews.x: This is NOT Coty Wild Musk oil. It does not even smell remotely like the musk I used to use. Very disappointed.
Absolutely is NOT Coty Wild Musk.  Not even close to the scent of Musk. To make things even more disappointing is there is no refund available.
Not the same of what grow up with, I really thought it was the original. I was very excited about this but it's not the same.
Has no smell. It took almost 30 days to receive it
No no nonooooooo Fake scam Rip-off How many ways can I say it. "Don't Buy This"
If anybody knows Coty Wild musk they know that that is definitely NOT it!

I purchased this as a gift for my husband who had been looking for the Coty Cologne since we met 12 years ago. I wasn’t sure if this was what he was looking for but when he opened the bottle and smelled it, he got a big smile and said, yep, this is it! Thank you! Where did you find it? I told him and he was overjoyed to have his favorite scent again. Thank you for recreating a product we both love! You need to sell a bigger bottle as well!

Ok so i have not purchased this yet but im wondering if some of you ladies wd shake the bottle then apply to your wrist if it wd smell better .. the thought of no more wild musk oil is a sad thing. Im hoping maybe the results will be different if some of you applied it not just smelled it thru the bottle. Please try and leave another review so the rest of us will know.

I totally agree with everyone..The 1980's coty musk was the only perfume I ever wore. I would be soooo happy if the company would remanufactured the original and put it back on the market. Perhaps if enough would write the company or open an online petetion to the company they woukd consider it. Just a desperate thought.

I am a Coty Wild Musk person since I was 16, and that has been a while since I saw that age, but I saw this musk oil on the amazon site and decided to buy it. When I got it, the bottle was so small for the price, but it was a cute little bottle, and said 100%. I put it on this morning, and can vaguely smell it. Oh well!

I was going to buy this until I read the review, as some this smell reminds me of my mom. It was the 1st perfume she ever bought me, it was in a small brown bottle with a little dipping stick. The closes I've come to find is sold at walgreens is called Skin musk!! I believe it 13.99 here in California

If you just have a few dollars to waste, then go ahead and buy this product! I used to wear Coty Wild Musk years ago and I absolutely loved its fragrance but this "stuff" smells terrible! I hate leaving negative reviews but this is my honest opinion about this product...sorry!

I used to buy and use the original product. I still have a small amount of it, even though it haven’t been made for years. I was excited to see this product, which claimed to be the original. But is doesn’t smell right, or even good. It is also thinner. Not the same at all.

Not even close to Coty. This smells GROSS! It contains Eugenol (clove oil) and it smells like it!  They did however refund my money when I complained. But don't but if you are looking for Coty musk. This is something spicy you might like that, I did not.

I have been using for years but I mistook this original for what is currently on the market - unfortunately I opened it - very small bottle for the worst chemical smell - I poured it out and threw it away.  Never to buy again.

claims.text: Most reviewers say the scent does not match the original Coty musk oil they remember.
Many reviewers report the product has little to no smell or a weak scent.
Several reviewers complain the bottle is very small.
Some reviewers mention long shipping times.
A few reviewers note the product is not returnable or has no refund available.
